description: NaZn(PO₃)₃ crystallizes in the cubic I̅43d space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.47 Å. Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form ZnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.12 Å) and three longer (2.13 Å) Zn-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-55°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.63 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent P atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one P atom.
